dict.string: BoxAI Desktop records only while you use the composer microphone to turn your spoken prompt into editable text. Audio is transcribed locally and is not uploaded.
A task you run may need to read or save files on your Desktop. BoxAI Desktop never scans this folder on its own.
A task you run may need to read or save files in Documents. BoxAI Desktop never scans this folder on its own.
A task you run may need to read or save files in Downloads. BoxAI Desktop never scans this folder on its own.
A task you run may need to read an image from your photo library. BoxAI Desktop never scans your photos on its own.
